testcase.name: registry rejects malformed, duplicate and weak configuration
missing or partial environment configuration fails closed
signed admin cookie verifies without exposing its secret or password hash
malformed, forged, expired and future tokens are rejected
disabled users, removed users, changed roles and password resets revoke access
cookie parsing rejects duplicates and does not accept similarly named cookies
every mutation requires current admin, same origin and session-bound CSRF
cookie attributes protect JavaScript access and add Secure on HTTPS
Next internal URL normalization preserves the exact validated loopback browser origin
configured HTTPS reverse-proxy origin is canonical and rejects hostile public hosts
request bodies require bounded JSON objects
sign-in rejects invalid credentials generically and issues an admin cookie
login and logout reject cross-origin requests; logout clears a valid cookie
current environment account changes are checked at each request
throttling rejects repeated attempts and provides retry guidance
account CLI provisions, resets and disables multiple local admins without printing credentials
only explicit endpoints and methods can reach the engine
engine origin cannot be a remote host, credential URL or arbitrary path
mutation bodies must be bounded JSON objects
dashboard hides upstream CSRF and rewrites only allowed report URLs
writes use a fresh server-side token and never forward browser credentials
report formats preserve downloads, masked text and protected nested links
stale reports, malformed upstream and outages fail without sensitive errors
uppercase UUID requests retain the report's canonical protected CSV link
